label: Cheap gym from a high corner
prompt: A photorealistic wide, downward-looking picture of a cramped, cheap basement gym in a small English town, taken from a fixed point high in one corner of the ceiling, close to the wall, as if a small unattended camera were bolted up there and nobody was behind it. Nothing is framed for effect: the bench press sits slightly off to the left, a rack of mismatched rubber-coated dumbbells and a cracked mirror fill the right, and the floor is scuffed black rubber matting with a bald patch near the door. On the bench lies a gangly young man with a long pale face, a weak chin, a patchy ginger-brown beard that has not decided to grow, narrow sloping shoulders and a washed-out grey hoodie rolled up to his elbows, straining under a bar loaded with thin plates and shaking visibly. Standing over his head, spotting him, is a heavy-set older man with a shaved head, thick grey stubble, a sunburnt neck, a belly pushing out a faded navy vest, and the tired, patient expression of someone who has watched this go wrong before. Both are small in the frame, seen from above and slightly to the side, their faces tilted and partly foreshortened. The only light is two flickering tube lights in the ceiling, giving a flat greenish-white wash, with a dim doorway of daylight at the far end that burns out to pale white. The picture is soft and slightly smeared, low in resolution, with faded washed-out colour, muted greens and greys, visible noise in the shadows and gently bowed edges from a cheap wide lens, filling the whole frame edge to edge with only the room itself in view. Thanks.

label: Attic at night from open laptop
prompt: A photorealistic picture of a rented attic bedroom at night, seen from a laptop left open and propped on a rumpled duvet at the foot of a single bed, so the lens looks slightly up and across at the room, close to the floor and tilted a few degrees off level. A very thin young man with a round, doughy, spotty face, small close-set eyes, big ears, a scrubby neck beard and uncombed black hair is on his back on a bare patch of carpet between the bed and a sloping roof beam, hands clasped behind his head, in the middle of a crunch, face screwed up with effort. He wears a huge stained charcoal hoodie, grey jogging bottoms gone shiny at the knees and one white sock with a hole in the heel. His phone lies on the carpet beside his head and is the main light: a cold blue-white glow from below that lights his chin, nostrils and the underside of the sloping ceiling, and leaves the rest of the attic in deep murk. Around him are a heap of unwashed clothes, a mug with a skin of something in it, a bare mattress edge, a clothes rail bowed under hoodies, and a small dormer window showing a dull orange streetlight smear. The picture is dark and grainy as if the camera is struggling in low light, with crushed shadows, smudged detail, slightly blown highlights where the phone glows, washed-out colour and a faint softness, and it fills the whole frame edge to edge with only the room and the people in it. Thanks.

label: Ambulance interior, ceiling corner view
prompt: A photorealistic wide picture of the inside of a parked ambulance's patient bay, taken from a small fixed lens tucked into the ceiling corner above the rear doors, looking down the length of the compartment, with nobody operating it and no movement in the framing. The curved wall is lined with cupboards of grey plastic, a strapped-in oxygen cylinder and a pale yellow sharps bin. On the stretcher lies a skinny young man with a narrow lopsided face, a broken-looking nose, bad skin on his forehead, pale eyebrows and a flat blond fringe stuck down with sweat, wearing a thin white t-shirt and one trainer. His right arm lies across his chest wrapped in an enormous lumpy mess of white medical tape and a sagging crepe bandage, fingers poking out puffy and purple, and in his other hand he gripping a plain unmarked plastic shaker bottle of chalky beige liquid, looking at it with a mixture of pride and shame. Seated beside him on a fold-down seat is a stocky woman paramedic in her thirties with a square freckled face, a short practical brown ponytail, wide set tired eyes and a green uniform with the sleeves pushed up, one gloved hand on his wrist, her mouth set in flat disbelief. Both are seen from above and foreshortened, small in the picture. The only light is a hard, cold white strip across the ceiling that makes the steel and plastic shine, with the street outside turning the rear window into a pale blur. The picture is slightly soft, faded and low in resolution, with muted greens and greyish whites, noise in the corners and gentle bowing at the edges from a cheap wide lens, filling the whole frame edge to edge with only the vehicle interior in view. Thanks.
